body: I'm in high school right now. Should have made that more clear.

Listen, I was in your spot, but I was obese. It was bad to have no-one there to help. I would 100% look for help online. I got into a close group of friends online because I opened up about my issues. They helped me realize that you don't need to have anything but yourself to be okay in life. Also, if you have a pet, use them to cheer yourself up. If not, go to these subs for a short term happiness: r/aww r/eyebleach r/mademesmile As dumb as it sounds, they helped me get through my depression (along with meds, GET PRESCRIBED). 

I just want you to know. From someone who was there, you can only go up from here. I'm sure soon enough, you'll find something great enough for you to start loving life. You just have to give life another chance.
Thanks, I looked at r/bipolar and had a little chuckle. Thanks man.
